name: jyut-ocr-proofread
description: Transcribe and proofread historical Chinese PDFs and OCR Markdown with Cantonese jyut-ocr conventions, scoped TOC reconciliation, typed release evidence, replayable long-book assembly, source/render provenance, and deterministic release audits.

interface.shortDescription: Transcribe and audit historical Chinese PDF OCR.
interface.longDescription: Use a Cantonese jyut-ocr workflow to transcribe and proofread historical Chinese PDFs: preserve printed glyph variants, editorial notation and old punctuation; isolate long-book page ranges safely; reconcile full or volume-scoped TOCs with explicit partitions; detect duplicate or missing scans; reconstruct cross-page text, footnotes, headings, lists and tables; and replay assembly while validating typed evidence, source exceptions and release dependency closure before delivery.
defaultPrompt: 校對一份 jyut-ocr Markdown，逐頁對同名 PDF。
識別一份長篇歷史中文 PDF，分段校對後安全合併。
對賬長目錄、分組同正文題名，獨立覆核實質異文。
重播長書 assembly，驗證 release plan 同 evidence closure。
